citation.title: Effective thermal conductivity estimation using a convolutional neural network and its application in topology optimization
citation.authors: Andre Adam, Huazhen Fang, Xianglin Li
citation.venue: Energy and AI 15 (2024) 100310 (Crossref; published online 2023-10-19 per the pool record; gold open access, CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 per Crossref and OpenAlex)
citation.version_coded: none: only the abstract was read (pool record from OpenAlex; the DOAJ record repeats it). The version of record could not be retrieved

claim.primary_outcome_paraphrase: Not coded (no accessible full text). Abstract only: a VGG-style CNN predicts effective thermal conductivity of a 128×128 binary image in 15 ms, stated as 3-5 orders of magnitude faster than a finite volume simulation.
claim.claimed_speedup_basis: Not coded. The abstract states a range of 3 to 5 orders of magnitude for one CNN prediction (15 ms, 128×128 image) against one finite volume simulation; this is a per-evaluation forward comparison, and no optimization-level time is given in the abstract.
claim.alternatives: Abstract: training on 130,000 binary images; test MAPE 0.35% at a solid-to-fluid conductivity ratio of 10 and 2.35% for aluminium and water; inside topology optimization the CNN keeps a MAPE of 0.67-11.8% across cases and brings the structure close to a theoretical maximum.

The article is open access (CC BY-NC-ND), so a human verifier can read it in a browser. Pointers from the abstract for the verifier: the only quantitative classical comparison in the abstract is per-evaluation (CNN prediction vs finite volume simulation of effective conductivity). Under §5.1 rule 1 it would be the primary outcome and a speed-stratum cost proxy, as for P00149 (per-evaluation surrogate vs FE homogenization inside TO). If the full text holds no optimization-level comparison and the verifier rejects the proxy, FT-FORWARD is the likely exclusion code. The TO is heat conduction in a two-phase (solid and fluid) medium [inferred from the abstract]. Screening code was I-SPEED. No author named Jun Wang.
